name: branding-navy-finance-pitch-and-brand-guide-slide-collage
title: Navy Finance Brand Guide Slide Collage
whatItIs: A pale board of many slides for a finance app: a welcome slide with a script wordmark, contents, problem and principle pages, a growth chart, colour and type slides (Navy, Gray, Helvetica Neue), logo and browser-tab mockups, alternating white and navy backgrounds.
whatItMeans: Alternating pale and deep navy slides create rhythm, and italic serif emphasis words add elegance to a plain sans system.
techniques: Italic serif accent word in each headline
Consistent small header and footer chrome
Ruled footer line on every slide
Palette and type slides as compact swatch and specimen cards
bestFor: Presenting a whole deck at a glance

vocabulary.definition: Many slides arranged together as an overview.
A word set in a contrasting style within a headline.
Repeated header and footer details across slides.
